description: This PHP source file defines the CsrfTokenManager class within the OrangeHRM system, extending Symfony's CSRF token management to include application-specific integrations and methods. It handles CSRF token creation and validation, utilizing traits for dependency injection and interacting with services for token storage.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Authentication\Csrf\CsrfTokenManager
